author: Unity
description:
The Unity Toolbars API allows developers to customize the editor toolbar with buttons and tools to streamline workflows without requiring complex editor extensions. In this video we demonstrate how you can easily create practical, workflow-enhancing tools directly in the Unity Editor.

🔗 Learn more: https://on.unity.com/Toolbar_Docs
